Title: Light
Points: 2
1) Which colour of light bends the most in a prism?
a. Red
*b. Violet
c. Green

2) Sound travels faster in water than in air.
*a. True
b. False

Type: E
3) Explain why the sky looks blue.
a. Shorter wavelengths of sunlight scatter more in the air.

Type: F
4) The study of light is called what?
a. optics
b. Optics

Type: MT
5) Match each scientist to their discovery.
a. Newton = gravity
b. Curie = radioactivity

Type: ORD
6) Put these colours in rainbow order.
a. Red
b. Orange
c. Yellow

Type: MA
7) Which of these are primary colours of light?
*a. Red
b. Yellow
*c. Blue

Type: FMB
8) Light is a [electromagnetic] wave and travels at about 300,000 [km, kilometres] per second.

Type: JUM
9) A jumbled sentence question.
a. one
